assessor: primary agent under ADR 0026; development inference, not accepted semantic scorer
limits: One exposed development case with changed report administration; no comparative performance inference.
Explicit block is the reviewer recommendation, not an acceptance decision or proof of incorrect blocking.
Case coverage remains seven bounded investigations, three base-tree-only, twenty-two pending, zero admitted.
presence_interpretation: The single final claim concerns unsuccessful partial refresh and exit status, not active-body deadline enforcement or disabling optional RSS. Shared RSS/recovery vocabulary does not establish either finding.
required_witness: Execute the original CLI, configuration loader, listing transports, RSS/provider recovery and candidate persistence with controlled real HTTP responses for mixed healthy/blocked listings and failed RSS with no cache. Include healthy and total-blockage controls, record exit status and state, and distinguish service restart policy from an actually observed restart.
reviewer_demonstration_limit: The reviewer replaced listing and RSS functions and configuration loading; its exit-zero demonstration bypassed the real provider recovery and HTTP paths. Preserve it as reviewer evidence, not independent case truth.
source_inspection: The provider no-cache failure writes unavailable and raises SourceUnavailable without setting degraded. The partial-listing caller catches that exception; cmd_harvest returns nonzero only for an escaping exception or degraded provider. This supports investigating the reported scenario but is not an independent execution of it.
